messages.subject: Error in (RR) %*% InvGamma : non-conformable arguments
parts:
Hi
I want to calculate the fit function. I have the following error. How to solve this problem, given that I used a method dwls 

> mode22.SPE <- ' X1 =~ X11 + X21 + X31 + X41 + X51 + X61
+ X2 =~ X72 + X82 + X92 + X102 + X112 + X122 
+ X3 =~ X133 + X143 + X153 + X163 + X173
+ Z1 =~ Z11 + Z21 + Z31 + Z41 + Z51
+ Z2 =~ Z62 + Z72 + Z82 + Z92 + Z102
+ Y1 =~ Y11 + Y21 + Y31 + Y41 + Y51
+ 
+ Z1~ A* X1+ B* X2+ C* X3
+ Z2~ D*X1+ E*X2+ G*X3
+ Y1~H*Z1+I*Z2
+ 
+ 
+ dir_Z1:=H
+ dir_Z2:=I
+ 
+ dir_X1_TO_Y1:=0
+ ind1_X1_TO_Y1:=A*H
+ ind2_X1_TO_Y1:=D*I
+ tot_ind_X1_TO_Y1:= A*H+D*I
+ 
+ 
+ dir_X2_TO_Y1:=0
+ ind1_X2_TO_Y1:=B*H
+ ind2_X2_TO_Y1:=E*I
+ tot_ind_X2_TO_Y1:= B*H+E*I
+ 
+ 
+ dir_X3_TO_Y1:=0
+ ind1_X3_TO_Y1:=C*H
+ ind2_X3_TO_Y1:=G*I
+ tot_ind_4_TO_Y1:= C*H+G*I
+ 
+  
+ '
> 
> mode22.EST <-sem (model= mode22.SPE, data = X ,se="standard",test="standard", estimator ="DWLS")

> S <- cov(lavInspect(mode22.EST, "data"))
> sigma.hat <- lavInspect(fit.bis, "sigma.hat")
> R<-(S-sigma.hat)
> RR<-lav_matrix_vech(R)
> Gamma = diag(diag(S), ncol(S))
> InvGamma = solve(Gamma)
> f_DWLS = t(RR)%*%InvGamma%*%(RR)
Error in (RR) %*% InvGamma : non-conformable arguments
